feed.title: StreamShōgun Changelog
feed.subtitle: Release notes, new features, and improvements for StreamShōgun.

entry.title: v0.2.4 - Local Imports and First Launch
entry.summary:
Desktop M3U/M3U8 playlist and XMLTV/GZ guide imports use native file pickers to pass complete file paths. Demo imports use the saved playlist ID and avoid adding unsaved entries after a failure.

Settings and Support remain accessible with an empty library. Mac builds remain ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Apple Developer credentials are not configured.

entry.title: v0.2.3 — Native Mac Downloads and Window Fixes
entry.summary:
Native Intel and Apple Silicon installers, architecture-aware Mac updates, and fixes for Dock activation, picture-in-picture window focus, and disconnected monitors.

Mac builds are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Signing configuration is prepared for future Apple Developer credentials.

entry.title: v0.2.2 — Library and Checkout Reliability
entry.summary:
Fixed playlist cleanup, duplicate channels, overlapping browser guide restoration, and stale desktop caches.

Improved sign-in billing selection, checkout concurrency, subscription verification, and dependency security. Installer releases now verify update metadata and the packaged database.

entry.title: v0.2.1 — Stability & Safety Improvements
entry.summary:
New: IPC input validators (requireString, requireFiniteNumber), Discord reconnection backoff, PIP param validation, React ErrorBoundary component with retry button.

Improved: Removed dead secureFetch code, scheduler timeout guard, Discord RPC safety checks, PIP window cleanup, watch history transaction + auto-prune, Zustand .catch() guards, player page unhandled-rejection fixes.

Fixed: PLAYLIST_LOAD_URL gzip decompression bypass.

entry.title: v0.1.0 — Initial Release
entry.summary:
New Features: M3U playlist import, XMLTV EPG guides, smart channel matching (Pro), HLS playback, favorites & watch history, cloud sync (Pro), picture-in-picture (Pro), dark & light themes, auto refresh (Pro).

Improvements: Windows NSIS installer and portable EXE, search and filter across all channels, keyboard navigation for channel list, group channels by category.
